name: TeleDrop Bot
description: Telegram file-sharing bot with expiring links and automatic cleanup

TG_BOT_TOKEN.description: Your Bot token, Get it from @Botfather

OWNER_ID.description: An integer of consisting of your owner ID

APP_ID.description: your app id, take it from my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: your api hash, take it from my.telegram.org

CHANNEL_ID.description: Database channel ID; add the bot as admin in this channel

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL1.description: Optional first force-sub channel/group ID; use 0 to disable

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL2.description: Optional second force-sub channel/group ID; use 0 to disable

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL3.description: Optional third force-sub channel/group ID; use 0 to disable

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL4.description: Optional fourth force-sub channel/group ID; use 0 to disable

START_MESSAGE.description: Optional: start message of bot, use HTML parsemode format
START_MESSAGE.value:
Hello {first}

I can store private files in Specified Channel and other users can access it from special link.

FORCE_SUB_MESSAGE.description: Optional: Force Sub message of bot, use HTML parsemode format

ADMINS.description: A space separated list of user_ids of Admins, they can only create links

APP_VERSION.description: Optional application version reported to the control plane

CONTROL_PLANE_URL.description: Optional HTTPS URL of the central TeleDrop control plane

CONTROL_PLANE_INSTANCE_ID.description: Unique non-secret identifier for this bot deployment

CONTROL_PLANE_SECRET.description: Private HMAC secret for this bot deployment; never share it

CONTROL_PLANE_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL.description: Control-plane heartbeat interval in seconds; minimum 15

CONTROL_PLANE_METRICS_ENABLED.description: Enable aggregate metrics sync to the control plane

CONTROL_PLANE_METRICS_INTERVAL.description: Aggregate metrics sync interval in seconds; 300 to 86400

CONTROL_PLANE_METRICS_DAILY_WINDOW.description: Number of UTC calendar dates per metrics snapshot; 1 to 90

CONTROL_PLANE_METRICS_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS.description: Maximum outbox retries before a payload becomes a permanent failure

CONTROL_PLANE_METRICS_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS.description: Initial metrics retry backoff in seconds

CONTROL_PLANE_METRICS_RETRY_MAX_SECONDS.description: Maximum metrics retry backoff in seconds

CONTROL_PLANE_METRICS_OUTBOX_ACCEPTED_RE.description: Days to keep accepted outbox records (then cleaned up); default 7

CONTROL_PLANE_METRICS_OUTBOX_PERMANENT_R.description: Days to keep permanent-failure outbox records; default 30

CONTROL_PLANE_METRICS_OUTBOX_CLEANUP_LIM.description: Max outbox records removed per cleanup pass; default 100

CONTROL_PLANE_METRICS_OUTBOX_LEASE_SECON.description: Metrics outbox claim lease in seconds; default 3600

TIME.description: Delivered-file auto-delete delay in seconds; use 0 to disable

CLEANUP_MAX_ATTEMPTS.description: Maximum automatic cleanup failures before a delivery is marked exhausted

CLEANUP_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS.description: Initial cleanup retry backoff in seconds

CLEANUP_RETRY_MAX_SECONDS.description: Maximum cleanup retry backoff in seconds
